standard_prerequisites.name: Explicit 2-fibre product model
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows assuming T_2 = S_2 x_{S_1} T_1, making the morphisms of T_2 explicit pairs.

standard_prerequisites.name: Faithfulness checked on fibres
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces faithfulness of G and G' to faithfulness on each fibre category.

core_obligations: Assume the explicit fibre-product model for T_2 and reduce to fibrewise faithfulness.
Normalize: from G(alpha) = G(beta) pass to gamma = alpha^{-1} o beta with G(gamma) = id, so it suffices to show gamma = id.

Use local essential surjectivity of F to cover U so that G(y)|_{U_i} is in the essential image; restrict gamma and represent it as a morphism (1, gamma) in the fibre product whose G'-image is the identity.
Conclude gamma|_{U_i} = id by faithfulness of G', hence gamma = id locally on a covering, hence globally.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the identity-lifting case, localize along the essential image of F, and kill the local restrictions with the faithfulness of G' in the fibre-product model.
difficulty_reason: Requires the normalization trick, a covering localization argument, and the explicit morphism description in the fibre-product model, all chained before the final faithfulness conclusion.
